scenes.vo: People click your YouTube video. Then they leave.

scenes.meaning: Lots of clicks. Not much love.
scenes.vo: These are your wide reach videos. The title and thumbnail are doing their job. The video isn't keeping the promise. Open the retention graph and find the drop. Usually it's a slow intro, so cut it. And get to what the title promised, fast.

scenes.title: Add chapters.
scenes.subtitle: People skip to the part they came for, instead of leaving.
scenes.vo: And add chapters, so people skip to the part they came for, instead of leaving.
Then log it in Backsurge. It tracks stuff like chapters too, and shows you if watch time actually went up.

scenes.headline: Next: no views, no love.
scenes.vo: Next up, the videos with no views and no love. Follow for that one.
